title: Make the ghost button and breadcrumbs readable on the Discover and not-found photo heroes

source.ref: Visual sweep 2026-11-02: /discover, /discover/circles, /discover/spaces, /discover/journeys, /discover/events and every not-found page under Discover

detail:
The Discover pages and the not-found page open on a dark photo hero but sit on the Commons (light) surface. Two Commons rules re-inked the hero's chrome: members-ui.css paints every .btn in a Commons body with ink at (0,6,0) specificity, beating the kit's light .hero .btn-ghost rule, and site-shell.css paints every crumb in a Commons main with the muted and body ink. Result: 'Browse all', 'Browse the Circles', 'Just browse', 'What's happening' and 'Browse by town' were ink on near-black, as was the 'Discover' crumb. Fix: the kit's light ghost rule also covers .phero and carries a Commons-body selector that outranks the members rule; the crumb re-ink skips crumbs inside a .phero. No new colour literals.

 Fixed 2026-11-02; browser check: all five Discover ghost pills and the not-found pills compute to rgb(242,245,250), crumb links to rgb(201,211,224).
